mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dict_item (dict_id, value, label, sort_order, verdict, verdict_note) VALUES (#{dictId}, #{value}, #{label}, #{sortOrder}, #{verdict}, #{verdictNote})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dict_item WHERE dict_id = #{dictId} AND value = #{code} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM dict_item WHERE dict_id = #{dictId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dict_item WHERE dict_id = #{dictId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dict_item WHERE dict_id = #{dictId} AND value = #{value}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dict_item WHERE dict_id = #{dictId} AND value = #{value} AND id != #{excludeItemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dict_item SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
